# Fullstory

> Fullstory is a behavioral data and digital analytics platform that captures, analyzes, and activates customer and employee experience data across web and mobile applications.

Fullstory provides AI-powered session replay, product analytics, and data activation capabilities for understanding user behavior and optimizing digital experiences. The platform serves multiple use cases including customer experience optimization, employee productivity, and real-time personalization across industries.

## Key Topics

- Behavioral data
- Session replay
- Product analytics
- Digital experience
- Customer journey
- AI insights
- Data activation
- Real-time personalization
- Conversion optimization
- Fullstory Workforce
- Fullstory Anywhere
- StoryAI
- Mobile analytics
- User experience

## Core Platform

- [Fullstory | Behavioral Data & Digital Analytics Platform](https://www.fullstory.com): Fullstory homepage showcasing behavioral data platform with AI-powered analytics.
- [The Behavioral Data Platform](https://www.fullstory.com/platform): Main platform overview highlighting behavioral data, personalization, and AI insights.
- [StoryAI | AI-Powered Product Analytics & Insights](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/storyai): StoryAI AI-powered analytics transforming behavioral data into actionable insights.

## Analytics & Session Replay

- [Fullstory Analytics: Customer Journey Intelligence & Experience Analytics](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/analytics): Fullstory Analytics product page with session replay, funnels, and heatmaps.
- [Product Analytics Platform | Analyze User Data with Fullstory](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/product-analytics): Product analytics features including session replay, dashboards, and journey mapping.
- [User Session Replay Tool | Capture Website & Mobile App User Sessions with Replay Technology](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/session-replay): Session replay technology for capturing and analyzing user behavior with AI summaries.

## Mobile & Web Applications

- [Lightweight Mobile App Analytics | iOS, Android, React Native & Flutter](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/mobile-apps): Mobile analytics for iOS, Android, React Native, and Flutter with session replay.
- [Guides and Surveys: In-App User Guidance for Product Adoption & User Onboarding](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/guides-surveys): In-app guidance and surveys for product adoption and user onboarding.

## Data Activation & Integration

- [Fullstory Anywhere: Connect Behavioral Data to Every Touchpoint](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/anywhere): Fullstory Anywhere for data unification and real-time personalization across platforms.
- [Anywhere: Warehouse | Unified Data & Data Warehouse Integration for Predictive Models](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/anywhere/warehouse): Data warehouse integration with Snowflake and BigQuery for predictive analytics.
- [Anywhere: Activation | Data Activation for Real-Time Personalization & Proactive Support](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/anywhere/activation): Data activation for real-time personalization with Salesforce and Intercom integration.

## Workforce & Employee Experience

- [Fullstory Workforce | Workflow Optimization & Digital Employee Experience Platform](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/workforce): Fullstory Workforce for employee experience, productivity, and workflow optimization.
- [Employee Productivity Analytics | Workforce Software for Better Workflows](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/workforce/productivity): Employee productivity analytics and workforce software for optimized workflows.
- [Internal IT Support | Cut Helpdesk Tickets & Resolve Issues Fast](https://www.fullstory.com/platform/workforce/internal-support): Internal IT support solution reducing helpdesk tickets and accelerating resolution.

- [Fintech Analytics: Product Insights for Financial Services & Consumer Banking Apps](https://www.fullstory.com/industries/finance-insurance): Fintech and banking analytics for digital trust and compliance with fraud detection.
